parent_objective: design bounded static config-patch application route from audited repair-plan artifacts
blocked_by: M2376 accepts repair-plan artifacts but no bounded application/config-patch route is designed
repair execution remains blocked until config-patch artifacts are designed, materialized, and audited
supersedes: direct active config overwrite from repair-plan artifacts
direct repair execution or training from repair-plan artifacts

public_gates: M2377 must design static config-patch artifacts from M2375 repair-plan outputs without applying them
M2377 must preserve collision, R4, diagnostic, mixed guarded, actor-input, oracle-feature, and active-config-overwrite guardrails
M2377 must choose a bounded artifact-only materialization route or stop the branch
M2377 must keep repair execution, training, ranking, paper, current-sim verdict, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns audited repair-plan artifacts into a bounded static config-patch application design without applying repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if config-patch design would overwrite active configs
stop if reward/curriculum patches cannot preserve guardrail constraints
stop if design routes directly to training or ranking
stop if design claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
fallback_plan: route to repair-plan artifact schema repair if patch design cannot preserve guardrails
route to branch synthesis if no bounded application route is supported
route to artifact-only config-patch materializer if design is bounded
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2376 accepts repair-plan artifacts and requires bounded application design

allowed_updates: M2377 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: static config-patch artifact schema is specified
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2377 designs repair-plan application route and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2377; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2375 repair-plan artifacts and M2376 audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Application design remains an engineering route, not driver capability evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: prepares config-patch application route from repair-plan artifacts but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit static config-patch materialization but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2377 cannot specify a bounded config-patch route
M2377 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: A bounded application design can map repair-plan artifacts to static config-patch artifacts while preserving guardrails and active-config safety.
success_criteria: reward-delta and curriculum-weight patch scopes are specified
collision, R4, diagnostic, mixed guarded, active-config, actor-input, oracle-feature, ranking, paper, current-sim verdict, and self-ID guardrails remain blocked
a bounded follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2377 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2377 executes repair levers or trains
M2377 overwrites active config or changes actor inputs
M2377 injects hidden/oracle features or profile-specific tuning
M2377 ranks support policies or controller families

M2377 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
